title: Video-DeepResearch: Towards the Next-Generation Multimodal Deepresearch Agent
title_zh: Video-DeepResearch：迈向下一代多模态深度研究 Agent
abstract_en: We introduce Video-DeepResearch (Video-DR), extending multimodal agents from static images to continuous video streams, a setting that demands dense spatiotemporal grounding coupled with open-web exploration. Preliminary evaluations reveal two critical bottlenecks in current models: (1) modality bias, where agents bypass visual tools in favor of textual search, and (2) parametric knowledge leakage, where models rely on internal memory rather than genuine tool-augmented execution. To address these challenges, we propose Video-DR, featuring a decoupled perception-exploration pipeline with stage-wise tool unlocking that compels exhaustive cross-frame visual grounding prior to web retrieval. Our framework adopts a two-stage training recipe: supervised fine-tuning followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), enabling autonomous exploration that breaks the imitation-learning ceiling. Furthermore, we curate Video-DR-Bench, a human-AI collaborative benchmark comprising 200 complex, multi-hop VQA instances. Empirical results demonstrate that our Video-DeepResearch-35B-A3B establishes a new state-of-the-art of 64.0% average accuracy, surpassing proprietary Claude-4.5-Sonnet (59.0%) by 5.0 points and significantly outperforming GPT-5 (52.5%) and Gemini 2.5 Pro (57.5%). The 30B-A3B variant achieves 59.3%, competitive with Claude-4.5-Sonnet and demonstrating the effectiveness of our training paradigm even at compact scale. Code: https://github.com/Osilly/Vision-DeepResearch.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 Video-DeepResearch（Video-DR），将多模态 Agent 从静态图像扩展到连续视频流场景，要求模型同时具备密集时空定位能力与开放网络探索能力。作者指出当前模型存在两类关键瓶颈：一是模态偏置（modality bias），即 Agent 倾向于绕过视觉工具而依赖文本搜索；二是参数知识泄漏（parametric knowledge leakage），即模型依赖内部记忆而非真实执行工具增强推理。为此，Video-DR 采用解耦的感知—探索流程，并通过分阶段工具解锁机制，强制模型在进行网页检索前完成充分的跨帧视觉定位。训练上，框架结合监督微调（SFT）与 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO），使 Agent 能进行自主探索并突破模仿学习上限。作者还构建了 Video-DR-Bench，一个由人机协作生成的基准，包含 200 个复杂多跳视频问答实例。实验显示，Video-DeepResearch-35B-A3B 平均准确率达到 64.0%，超过 Claude-4.5-Sonnet 的 59.0%，并显著优于 GPT-5 和 Gemini 2.5 Pro；30B-A3B 版本也达到 59.3%，验证了该训练范式在较小规模模型上的有效性。
key_points_zh: 提出 Video-DR，将 DeepResearch 类多模态 Agent 从图像扩展到连续视频流，强调跨帧时空 grounding 与开放网页探索的结合。
识别当前多模态 Agent 的两大问题：模态偏置导致过度依赖文本搜索，参数知识泄漏导致模型用内部记忆替代真实工具调用。
设计解耦的感知—探索 pipeline 与分阶段工具解锁机制，要求模型先完成充分视频理解，再进行网页检索和多跳推理。
采用 SFT + GRPO 两阶段训练，使模型从模仿工具使用转向自主探索，提升复杂任务求解能力。
构建 Video-DR-Bench，包含 200 个复杂多跳 VQA 样本；Video-DeepResearch-35B-A3B 达到 64.0% 准确率，超过 Claude-4.5-Sonnet、GPT-5 和 Gemini 2.5 Pro。

llm_assessment.comment: Strong video-agent work with tool-augmented exploration, visual grounding, training, and benchmark contributions, though not clearly focused on realtime latency.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项较强的视频智能体工作，结合了工具增强探索、视觉定位、训练与基准贡献，但实时低延迟重点不够明确。
